elements.justification: The turning vehicle y is of the admitted aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle ('every device in, upon or by which any person or property is or may be transported or drawn upon a highway'); 'the driver' is read through its controlled motion.
'within an intersection': rel.occupies 'a road user's footprint overlaps a lane / region' of y and the st.intersection i that x enters.

'having so yielded': the yield of o1 is completed before the turn the words then permit ('having so yielded ... may make such left turn'), so it is judged from y's latest entry into i up to the onset of its turn, not over the turn itself. The onset is the latest observation, at or after y's latest entry into i (drv.motion.entering_region y i), at which y is turning left (drv.motion.turning_left: 'it is moving ... and its yaw rate (kin.yaw_rate, deg/s, left positive) exceeds yaw_floor') and either was not turning left at the observation before (a rise) or enters i there; y occupies i (rel.occupies, st.intersection) at every observation from that onset to now. The composition (NRS_484B_253_o1 {x -> y}, compliance) is read at every observation from that entry up to and including the onset.

'having given a signal': sig.turn_indicator state left ('the signal that precedes a manoeuvre') or sig.hand_signal meaning left ('a driver's or rider's arm signal'), at some observation from y's latest arrival onto its approach carrier c2 (drv.motion.entering_region y c2: 'its footprint overlaps r (rel.occupies) at the observation and did not at the observation before') up to the onset of its turn (s8), the words placing the signal before the turn ('having given a signal ... may make such left turn'); c2 is the carrier (st.travel_region, st.lane_enters c2 i) y occupied at its latest entry into the intersection, y having occupied c2 or the intersection at every observation from that arrival to the onset. Neither signal is a stand-in for the turn itself, which s11 reads.

'may make such left turn': y is making it at this observation, turning left now (drv.motion.turning_left: moving, kin.yaw_rate left positive above resolution) or having turned left since entering the intersection by at least the turn recognition angle (drv.motion.heading_change_since_entry 'the signed heading change of road user x since its footprint last began to overlap region r'). Where the turn began is read on s8 (the latest onset of drv.motion.turning_left since the entry).
'the drivers of all other vehicles': x, any vehicle of the admitted aggregate other than the turning one, read through its controlled motion.

'approaching the intersection': x occupies an approach carrier c (st.lane_enters 'the intersection region a directed approach carrier runs into at its entrance end') and its yield is decided at its entry (drv.motion.entering_region). 'from the opposite direction' relative to the turning vehicle: c and the carrier c2 y occupied at its latest entry into the intersection (drv.motion.entering_region y i, read through a past operator) have opposed designated directions (drv.road.opposed_directions), as rel.oncoming's 'not a stand-in' clause directs.

'shall yield the right-of-way' (DEF-NRS-484A-210, 'the right of one vehicle ... to proceed in a lawful manner in preference to another vehicle'): x does not enter the intersection while the turning vehicle is owed precedence.
'the vehicle making the left turn': the vehicle y (admitted aggregate) in the intersection that s11 reads as making the turn, having so yielded (s8) and signalled (s9).

residues.why: 'when and as required' refers to the signalling requirements of a law outside this corpus (no bracketed id resolves it); the signal itself is read on s9.

applicability: x is a vehicle (ru.aggregate=DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle) and enters intersection i (st.intersection) at this observation (drv.motion.entering_region x i) from an approach carrier c it occupies at this observation (rel.occupies x c, st.travel_region, st.lane_enters c i).
obligation: For every intersection i and carrier c the applicability selects (bound again with its whole selection: st.intersection i, st.travel_region c, rel.occupies x c, st.lane_enters c i, drv.motion.entering_region x i), no vehicle y other than x (ru.aggregate=DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle) is making a left turn in i under the words' conditions, which are: (1) the onset of y's turn: read through a past operator, there is a latest observation, at or after y's latest entry into i, at which y occupies i, is turning left (drv.motion.turning_left y with p.speed_resolution and p.yaw_rate_resolution) and either was not turning left at the observation before (the turning rises) or enters i there (drv.motion.entering_region y i); y has occupied i at every observation from that onset to now, and no later observation is such an onset; (2) at that onset, read through a past operator: y has occupied i at every observation since its latest entry into i (drv.motion.entering_region y i), at which entry observation y occupied a carrier c2 (rel.occupies y c2, st.travel_region, st.lane_enters c2 i) with drv.road.opposed_directions c c2 (p.opposed_carriers_cosine); (3) y has so yielded: rule NRS_484B_253_o1 {x -> y} complied with at every observation from that entry up to and including the onset, and not read after the onset (the yield the words require is completed before the turn they then permit; vehicles reaching the intersection after the turn has so begun are those this duty makes yield); (4) y has given a signal (sig.turn_indicator left, or sig.hand_signal left) at some observation from its latest arrival onto c2 (drv.motion.entering_region y c2) up to and including the onset, y having occupied c2 or i at every observation from that arrival to the onset; (5) the source declares int.left_turn y i at this observation; (6) y is making the turn at this observation (drv.motion.turning_left y with p.speed_resolution and p.yaw_rate_resolution, or drv.motion.heading_change_since_entry y i with step p.heading_since_step_carla_scene_graph at least p.turn_recognition_angle). Where y's entry into i, its arrival onto c2 or the onset of its turn is not observed, the conditions that turn on it are unknown.

narrowings.why: 'the driver' of the turning vehicle is read through its controlled motion.
'the drivers' are read through the vehicles' controlled motion.
The yield is judged at x's entry into the intersection while the turning vehicle is in it.

scenarios.name: forbid
scenarios.narrative: The recording begins with y on a carrier upstream of c2; y comes onto c2 and signals with sig.turn_indicator left on c2, int.left_turn y i declared, enters i through c2 (recorded), waits in i, and begins its left turn while no opposing vehicle is in the scene; it keeps turning (kin.yaw_rate 15 deg/s, 4 m/s); x appears on c (opposed to c2) only after the onset of y's turn and enters i while y is still turning.

scenarios.name: permit
scenarios.narrative: x waits on c and enters i after y has left it, as the only road user in i.

scenarios.name: idle
scenarios.narrative: x drives along a road segment and enters no intersection.

scenarios.name: blind
scenarios.narrative: As forbid, with y's arrival on c2, its entry into i and the onset of its turn recorded, but neither sig.turn_indicator nor sig.hand_signal of y is observed.

scenarios.name: branch_1
scenarios.narrative: As forbid, but y's sig.turn_indicator is off and sig.hand_signal no_signal at every observation: y gave no signal, and x owes it no precedence under this duty.

scenarios.name: branch_2
scenarios.narrative: As forbid, but x is in the scene throughout and y's turn begins while x is 15 m from i at 15 m/s on c, so NRS_484B_253_o1 is not complied with by y at the onset: y has not so yielded.

scenarios.name: branch_3
scenarios.narrative: As forbid, but y turns past the turn recognition angle after its lawful onset and then stands still in i; x appears after the onset and enters i while y stands mid-turn.

scenarios.name: branch_4
scenarios.narrative: As forbid, but y lights its left indicator only after the onset of its turn and gives no signal before it: y had not given a signal when it began the turn.
